name: Black Corporation Xerxes MK2
description: Black Corporation Xerxes MK2 eight-voice polyphonic synthesizer: every controller of its manual's MIDI CC chart, its pots on the chart's CHANNEL 1 and its buttons on CHANNEL 2.

sources.title: XERXES MK2 Operation Manual 1.1.1
sources.notes: MIDI CC chart (pages 38, 39, 40 of the PDF) read by tools/profiles/blackcorp/import-black.mjs from xerxes_mk2_manual_1.1.1_eng.pdf (sha256 a9b9658ff7a019f2114611832770c573b7959ba4e2ddd7e4e7bde583bbc6067e), https://black-corporation.com/m/assets/support/1/xerxes_mk2_manual_1.1.1_eng.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/blackcorp/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/blackcorp/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI CC chart, sent as a control change. Its name is the chart's less the kind of control (SLIDER, POT, KNOB, BUTTON, SWITCH), which its description keeps. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

The chart sets the pots under CHANNEL 1 and the buttons under CHANNEL 2, the same controller numbers on both, and says no more: whether those are channels 1 and 2 or the instrument's MIDI channel and the one after it, the manual does not say. The pots are sent on the channel variable (1), the buttons on secondChannel (2); set both to what the instrument answers on.
The chart prints no values: every controller is 0 - 127, the buttons included. The names are the chart's, its underscores read as spaces and its spelling kept (DINAMIC).
Names the chart prints on more than one controller, each laid out and named with its number: POT_LFO2_FREQ, CC 60 and 81; POT_LFO2_DEPTH, CC 61 and 80; POT_LFO2_DELAY, CC 62 and 82.

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these same controllers when its panel is used, where its MIDI settings allow
